description: This file defines the MySugar class which manages dashboard dashlets in the SuiteCRM system, including adding, displaying, configuring, and searching dashlets.

classes.name: MySugar
classes.description: A class managing user dashboard dashlets, including adding, rendering, deleting, and searching dashlets, with support for configuration and layout management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for MySugar class, initializes the dashlet type.

methods.name: checkDashletDisplay
methods.description: Determines if the dashlet should be displayed based on user permissions and module support.

methods.name: addDashlet
methods.description: Handles adding a new dashlet for the current user session, including security checks and cache building.

methods.name: displayDashlet
methods.description: Displays a specific dashlet based on its ID, processing display or configuration requests.

methods.name: getPredefinedChartScript
methods.description: Retrieves and displays predefined chart scripts for a specified dashlet.

methods.name: deleteDashlet
methods.description: Removes a dashlet from the user’s dashboard by its ID.

methods.name: dashletsDialog
methods.description: Provides a dialog interface for adding dashlets, including rendering templates.

methods.name: searchModuleToolsDashlets
methods.description: Searches for dashlets within module or tools categories matching a search string.

methods.name: searchChartsDashlets
methods.description: Searches for chart dashlets matching a search string.

methods.name: searchDashlets
methods.description: Performs a search across dashlets based on category and search string.

methods.name: configureDashlet
methods.description: Loads dashlet options for editing or saves new options if submitted.

methods.name: saveLayout
methods.description: Saves the user’s dashlet layout configuration.
